description: NaTi₂Al₅O₁₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbam space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.47 Å) and two longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four AlO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-51°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.17 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There are two shorter (1.87 Å) and four longer (1.92 Å) Al-O bond lengths. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.96 Å. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with six AlO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-67°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.79 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Ti and two equivalent Al atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Al atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Al atoms to form distorted ONaAl₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂Al square pyramids, corners with three equivalent ONaAl₃ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂Al square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Ti and one Al atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Al atom to form distorted ONa₂Ti₂Al square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Ti₂Al square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaAl₃ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent ONa₂Ti₂Al square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONaAl₃ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Ti and three Al atoms.
